-1.help: Specifies an HTTP header to use in HTTP request.

-B.help: Starts slowhttptest in Slow POST mode, sending unfinished HTTP message bodies.

-H.help: Starts slowhttptest in SlowLoris mode, sending unfinished HTTP requests.

-R.help: Starts slowhttptest in Range Header mode, sending malicious Range Request header data.

-X.help: Starts slowhttptest in Slow Read mode, reading HTTP responses slowly.

-a.help: Sets the start value of range-specifier for Range Header attack.

-b.help: Sets the limit value of range-specifier for Range Header attack.

-c.help: Specifies the target number of connections to establish during the test.

-d.help: Specifies HTTP proxy server to connect to for all connections.

-e.help: Specifies HTTP proxy server to connect to for probe connections.

-f.help: Specifies the value of Content-Type header.

-g.help: Forces slowhttptest to generate CSV and HTML files when test fin‐ ishes with timestamp in filename.

-i.help: Specifies the interval between follow up data for slowrois and Slow POST tests.

-k.help: Specifies number of times the resource would be requested per socket in Slow Read test.

-m.help: Specifies the value of Accept header.

-n.help: Specifies the interval between read operations for Slow Read test.

-o.help: Specifies custom file name, effective with -g.

-p.help: Specifies the interval to wait for HTTP response on probe connec‐ tion, before marking the server as DoSed.

-s.help: Specifies the value of Content-Length header for Slow POST test.

-t.help: Specifies the verb to use in HTTP request.

-v.help: Specifies the verbosity level of logging.

-w.help: Specifies the start of the range the TCP advertised window size would be picked from in Slow Read test.

-x.help: Specifies the maximum length of follow up data for slowloris and Slow POST tests.

-y.help: Specifies the end of the range the TCP advertised window size would be picked from in Slow Read test.

-z.help: Specifies the number of bytes to read from receive buffer with each read() operation.
